question: What is the name of the portal inaugurated by Union Home Minister Amit Shah to connect Indian agencies with INTERPOL's network?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BHARATPOL.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the BHARATPOL portal developed by the CBI in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The BHARATPOL portal connects Indian law enforcement agencies to INTERPOL's network of 195 countries.**
 
• It facilitates international collaboration for crime control, including tracking fugitives, drug trafficking, and human trafficking.
 
• The portal provides real-time access to 19 INTERPOL databases, ensuring faster and more efficient investigations.
 
• Features like 'Trial in Absentia' simplify the prosecution of fugitive criminals in their absence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **INTERPOL:**__ The International Criminal Police Organization facilitates worldwide police cooperation. It provides tools like Red Corner Notices to track criminals globally.
 
• __**CBI:**__ The Central Bureau of Investigation acts as India's National Central Bureau for INTERPOL, coordinating international criminal investigations.
 
• __**Trial in Absentia:**__ A legal provision allowing the prosecution of fugitive criminals in their absence, ensuring justice is served while respecting due process.
 
• __**Aatmanirbhar Bharat:**__ A government initiative aimed at making India self-reliant across sectors, including defense and law enforcement.
